decision: Do not disable physical iPad WiFi while the active test/control tunnel itself uses localNetwork. A verified independent wired test channel is needed before a bounded WiFi-off/restoration acceptance can safely proceed. Device appearing connected does not prove USB.
next: Verify actualwiredCoreDevicetransport in an attended/cabledsetup before togglingWiFi. Do not repeatedly attempt the same radiotest under unchanged localNetworktransport.
